title: UnitedHealth Stock News (Oct 14, 2026): UNH Falls 0.2% to $377.76
summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) closed at $377.76, down 0.20%, on Oct 13 as an early rally on its Q3 beat and raised 2026 outlook faded.
body_markdown:
## Why UnitedHealth Stock Fell


According to the[company's third-quarter release filed with the SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000731766/000073176626000255/earningsrelease3q26unh.htm) on October 13, UnitedHealth earned $4.56 per share, or $4.69 on an adjusted basis, on revenue of $112.7 billion. Its medical care ratio was 88.4%, and the company now expects full-year 2026 adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share. CEO Stephen Hemsley said the results "reflect the discipline and execution our teams are bringing to every part of our business."


The reaction did not hold. As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/unitedhealth-stocks-slip-although-profit-212442747.html) , the stock slipped even as the profit outlook rose again, with the outlet framing the gap as one of confidence: the insurer is showing progress, but investors still need convincing that the recovery can stick. Neither source named a single trigger for the reversal from the morning highs.


## UNH Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- The medical care ratio improved to 88.4% from 89.9% a year earlier, according to the[Q3 earnings call transcript](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/unitedhealth-unh-q3-2026-earnings-235924187.html) published by Motley Fool.
- Management expects its Medicare Advantage margin near the top of its 2% to 4% range, per the same call.
- Cash flow from operations was $5.1 billion, or 1.2 times net income, according to the company's release.


### Risks


- On the call, management said commercial medical cost trend is running above its initial 11% expectation, citing specialty drug costs and No Surprises Act dispute awards.
- Management flagged uneven state funding for Medicaid, which it views as being at its margin trough in 2026.
- GuruFocus named pricing discipline, Optum execution and service quality as the next tests for the recovery.
